name: get_customer
description: Customer profile: tier, fraud-risk flag, prior contacts in the last 30 days, past interactions (long-term memory source).

name: list_customer_orders
description: List the customer's orders (id, status, items, total), newest first.

name: get_order
description: Full order details incl. lines, shipping, ETA, tracking. Fails with NOT_OWNER if the order belongs to another account.

name: get_payments
description: Payment method and transaction log (authorizations, captures) of an order.

name: check_promo
description: Validate a promo code for a customer.

name: create_return
description: Open a return for one line item.

name: issue_refund
description: Refund amount_usd. reason_code in DAMAGED_ITEM | WRONG_ITEM | DUPLICATE_CHARGE. Above 50 USD returns PENDING_APPROVAL (human-in-the-loop).

name: update_address
description: Change delivery address (before shipping, same country).

name: issue_voucher
description: Issue a 10% delay-compensation voucher (6-10 days late, once per order).

name: create_warranty_claim
description: Open a warranty claim for an electronics/appliance line within 12 months of delivery.

name: escalate_to_human
description: Hand the ticket to a human agent. reason_code in IDENTITY_VERIFICATION | FLAGGED_CUSTOMER | LOST_PARCEL | REPEATED_CONTACT | LEGAL_THREAT | HIGH_VALUE_REFUND | CUSTOMER_REQUEST.
